> Allowing values beyond [0, 1] or [-1, 1] is documented for each of the animation nodes [Blend2](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_animationnodeblend2.html#class-animationnodeblend2) [Blend3](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_animationnodeblend3.html#class-animationnodeblend3) [Add2](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_animationnodeadd2.html#class-animationnodeadd2) [Add3](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_animationnodeadd3.html#class-animationnodeadd3) [Sub2](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_animationnodesub2.html#class-animationnodesub2), so this does look like an intended feature. However, if this doesn't actually make sense, the change would need to be in the animation nodes' get_parameter_list to remove or_less,or_greater
